mapper.sql: CASE WHEN t.warn_min IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(b.quantity, 0) - COALESCE(b.reserved_quantity, 0) < t.warn_min THEN 'LOW' WHEN t.warn_max IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(b.quantity, 0) - COALESCE(b.reserved_quantity, 0) > t.warn_max THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_warning_threshold WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_warning_threshold SET warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, sku_id = #{skuId}, warn_min = #{warnMin}, warn_max = #{warnMax}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.warehouse_id, t.sku_id, t.warn_min, t.warn_max, t.remark, t.version, t.created_at, t.updated_at, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, k.sku_code, k.spec_name AS sku_name, k.spec_values, p.name AS product_name FROM inventory_warning_threshold t LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = t.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN product_sku k ON k.id = t.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.id = #{id}
